book.title: Book your nails
book.text: Choose services, a master and a time that suits you. The studio sees your booking right away.

visits.title: Your visits,
visits.text: A reminder before each visit, one tap to your calendar, and changes whenever you need them.

loyalty.title: Every visit
loyalty.text: Each visit is a stamp on your loyalty card, and some visits come with a discount.

home.title: Keep us
home.text: Add the app to your Home Screen: it opens full screen, like any app on your phone.

ready.title: You're
ready.text: Services, bookings, your loyalty card and the studio's contacts, all in one place.
